descriptions.value: The CoE SDO segmented download handler advances a write pointer by each incoming segment's size but does not track how many bytes have been written in total. A master can keep sending non-last segments until the pointer has walked past the end of the object buffer or the complete-access staging buffer.

assertions.title: CoE SDO Segmented Download Cumulative Out-of-Bounds Write

title: CoE SDO Segmented Download Cumulative Out-of-Bounds Write
